title: Deterministic quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games
summary: We give a deterministic algorithm that computes the complete zero-threshold winning set of a finite mean-payoff game with arbitrary signed integer edge weights encoded in binary. For total explicit input length L , it uses $`2^{O((\log(L+2))^2)}`$ bit operations. A reduction also computes the exact rational value at every vertex and globally optimal positional strategies for both players within the same quasipolynomial bound.
family_title: Quasipolynomial algorithms for mean-payoff, stochastic and parity games

review.reason: Gives a quasipolynomial deterministic algorithm for solving mean-payoff games.
